definitions.explanation: Without any delay or hesitation; right away. Most commonly used in the adverbial form {即座|そくざ}に.

examples.japanese: {即座|そくざ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{返事|へんじ}→返事：00844_henji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{即座|そくざ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{答|こた}えた→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧。
examples.english: He answered the question on the spot.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発覚|はっかく}→発覚：07629_hakkaku⟧し、{即座|そくざ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}られた→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: The problem was discovered, and countermeasures were immediately taken.

notes:
Almost always used in the adverbial form {即座|そくざ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧. Conveys a sense of decisiveness and lack of hesitation. More formal than ⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {即座|そくざ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to respond immediately
- {即座|そくざ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧ — to judge instantly
- {即座|そくざ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{答|こた}える→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧ — to answer on the spot
- {即座|そくざ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to act immediately

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ — right away (everyday)
- ⟦{直|ただ}ちに→直ちに：00398_tadachini⟧ — immediately (formal, often for orders/instructions)
- ⟦{瞬時|しゅんじ}→瞬時：13662_shunji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ — in an instant (emphasizes speed)
